public_rationale: OpenAI explicitly acknowledged similar limitations, supporting the weaknesses portion. Comparative exams also showed improved performance. Those facts do not settle the broader assertion about qualitative sameness: higher scores alone neither prove nor disprove it. A categorical verdict would depend on a boundary Marcus did not supply.
limitations: The cited comparisons come from the model developer.
Evidence for persistent weaknesses cannot establish that every important strength remained unchanged.
